description: June 22 birthday meaning: Gemini or Cancer cusp, birthday number 22, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, June 22 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer. In numerology the day gives birthday number 22, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a June 22 birthday
paragraphs: Cancer season usually begins on June 22nd, with the Sun at the first degree of the Crab, though certain years and birth times leave it in Gemini's final moments. Master number 22, the builder, kept whole here, suggests a protector with large plans. The cusp blend is often read as a nurturer who can also articulate exactly what a family or team needs.

By noon UTC on June 22, the Sun has normally reached roughly 0° of Cancer. That places the date in the Cancer decan that astrologers give to Moon, the first of three. Birthdays around June 20 to June 22 fall on the Gemini–Cancer cusp, which also lines up with the June solstice. Gemini's curiosity and talk meet Cancer's feeling and attachment to home. Whether the Sun had already entered Cancer at your birth depends on the year, the hour and the place, since the boundary shifts by up to a day across years; a natal chart answers that precisely. People who identify with both signs are often described as emotionally articulate, able to name what they feel and to listen closely, with a busy mind and a heart that stays near family.

sections.heading: Numerology of the June 22 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 22nd gives a birthday number of 22, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced. Sometimes called the Master Builder, 22 combines the 2's cooperation with the 4's practicality on a larger scale, suggesting an ability to turn big visions into working structures. Even in the secondary position of a birth day, it is given weight in numerology. People born on this day are often described as idealistic planners, capable of organising many people towards a shared goal. Pressure can come with that potential, so pacing themselves tends to matter a great deal.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same June 22 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master numbers 11 and 33. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: June 22 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A June birthday falls at the height of northern summer, around the longest days of the year, while in the southern hemisphere it marks the darkest stretch near the winter solstice. Gemini covers most of the month, with Cancer beginning around June 21. June is month 6 in numerology, a number of care, responsibility and home, which foreshadows the Cancerian turn at the month's end. June 22 is the 173rd day of the year (174th in a leap year). In most years Leo season is under way by July 23, 31 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a June 22 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. June 22 is also the birthday of Erich Maria Remarque (1898), Dan Brown (1964) and Giuseppe Mazzini (1805).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is June 22?
faq.answer: June 22 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Gemini or Cancer on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Cancer. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on June 22?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On June 22 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 22 for everyone born on the 22nd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on June 22?
faq.answer: By June 22 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on June 22?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a June 22 birthday are Erich Maria Remarque (1898), Dan Brown (1964) and Giuseppe Mazzini (1805). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
